NONE: › happiness and excitement
快樂，愉快，高興

example: I felt there was an air of forced gaiety about her manner.
我感到她有點強作歡顔的様子。

NONE: › happily or brightly
歡樂地，喜氣洋洋地；閃亮地，明亮地

example: I could hear her gaily singing in her bedroom.
我可以聽到她在睡房興高采烈地唱著歌。
The tree lights twinkled gaily across the lake.
湖對岸，樹上燈光閃爍，透出歡樂的氣氛。

I or T: B1 to get something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time
（尤指經過一段時間逐漸）取得，獲得，贏得，博得

NONE: C1 If a political party or an idea or belief gains ground, it becomes more popular or accepted.
變得更受歡迎；取得進展；得到肯定

I or T: B1 to increase in weight, speed, height, or amount

C or U: C1 an increase in something such as size, weight, or amount

I or T: › UK If a clock or watch gains, it works too quickly and shows a time that is later than the real time.

C or U: C1 an occasion when you get something useful or positive

example: The mayor has gained a lot of support from the teacher's union.
市長已經獲得教師工會很多人的支持。
What do you hope to gain from the course?
你希望從這門課程中學到些甚麽？
Alternative medicine has only just started to gain respectability in our society.
另類療法在社會上只是剛剛開始被認可。
[ + two objects ] It was her performances in Aida that gained her an international reputation as a soprano.
正是她在《阿伊達》中的表演使她獲得了國際知名女高音的聲譽。
After you've gained some experience teaching abroad, you can come home and get a job.
在獲得一些海外教學經驗後，你就可以回國找份工作。
From the late 19th century, European powers began to gain control of parts of the Ottoman Empire.
從19世紀晚期，歐洲列強開始取得對奧斯曼帝國一些地區的控制權。
She's certainly gained (in) confidence over the last couple of years.
毫無疑問，在過去幾年中，她樹立了自信。
The data exists all right - the difficulty is in gaining access to it.
資料確實是有的——難就難在怎様去取得它。
The thieves gained entrance through an upstairs window that was left open.
竊賊是從樓上一扇開著的窗戶鑽進來的。
The Republicans are gaining ground in the southern states.
共和黨在南部諸州越來越得人心。
I gained a lot of weight while I was on holiday.
我休假期間體重大增。
The car gained speed going down the hill.
下山時，車加速了。
Good economic indicators caused the share index to gain (by) ten points.
良好的經濟指標令股票指數上升了十點。
The campaign has been gaining momentum over the past few weeks.
該項運動的發展氣勢在過去的幾個星期愈發強勁。
My watch has gained (by) ten minutes over the last 24 hours.
在過去的24小時裡我的錶快了十分鐘。
Whatever the objections to this sort of treatment, the gains in terms of the number of lives saved are substantial.
不管對這種療法存在何種異議，就其挽救了眾多生命這一點而言，它的意義是重大的。
The minister was sacked for abusing power for his personal gain.
部長因濫用權力謀取私利而被解僱。
Side effects of the drugs may include tiredness, headaches, or weight gain.
這些藥物的副作用可能包括疲乏、頭痛或體重增加。
Oil prices rose again today after yesterday's gains.
油價繼昨天上漲後今天又進一步攀升。

NONE: › to get nearer to someone or something that you are chasing
逼近…；趕上…

example: Garcia was gaining on her opponent throughout the race, but only overtook her at the very end.
加西亞在整個賽跑過程中一點點逼近對手，但直到最後一刻才超過了她。

NONE: › something or someone that is in a better position or has more value at the end of a process
獲利者

example: There were both gainers and losers as a result of the tax changes.
稅收系統改變後，既有獲利者，也有受損者。

NONE: › providing money or something else that is useful
有報酬的；有收益的；有利可圖的

example: Many graduates tell of months spent in search of gainful employment.
很多畢業生都説，為了找到一份有報酬的工作，他們要花上數月的時間。

NONE: › to refuse to accept something as the truth
否認；反駁；反對

example: Certainly there's no gainsaying (= it is not possible to doubt) the technical brilliance of his performance.
無可否認，他的演奏技巧非常精湛。

NONE: › formal a particular way of walking
步態；步履
› the particular way a horse walks or runs
（馬）奔跑（或行走）的方式

example: He walked with a slow stiff gait.
他走起路來步履緩慢而僵直。
The pony's gait slowed from a canter to a trot.
小跑著的小馬放慢了速度。

NONE: › a pair of coverings for the lower half of the legs, often worn in the past but worn now mainly by people who go walking or climbing in order to stop earth and water from entering their boots
綁腿；護腿（源於舊時，現主要為登山者或徒步者所穿）
